suggestedChips: What does public domain mean here?

intents.reply: Hello — I can help you explore Matrika's languages, open records, map, or contribution guidelines.
You can inspect approximate regional locations across India on the interactive Language Map (also accessible via the region list below the map).
Visit the Audio Archive for spoken word slots, mock-mode players pending cleared recordings, and transcript panels.
Browse openly licensed and public-domain monochrome plates with creator credits in the Photo & Video Archive.
Openly licensed and public-domain records in the Digital Library include download buttons; restricted and metadata-only records never expose unauthorised files.
Matrika currently documents 10 language entries in the directory, with filters for script, family, and state/region.

1. Open the Contribution form. 2. Choose the material type, language, and creator attribution. 3. Confirm rights and consent (or request restricted access). In Review 1, submissions save locally in your browser preview queue.

phrases: what does public domain mean here
intents.reply: Public domain and open-licence records allow viewing and downloads with attribution. Permission-granted depends on access terms; restricted and metadata-only items withhold downloads to protect community consent.

Items marked 'Demo content' are Review 1 placeholders awaiting native-speaker verification. Map and profile regions are intentionally approximate (state or district level only) to protect privacy and sensitive sites.
Saved records are stored privately inside your browser's localStorage and can be viewed on the Explore Languages or Saved view.
